info.title: Library API
info.description: Generated from the route registry and the shared Zod contracts.

post.description: Always creates a READER. Sets the auth cookies; non-browser clients also receive the tokens in the body.
Reads the refresh cookie or the body token. Reusing a rotated-out token revokes its whole family.
Revokes the session family and clears cookies; works without a valid access token.

delete.description: Soft-disables the account (no hard delete) and revokes every session.

post.description: Refused with 409 GENRE_IN_USE while it is the only active genre of any active book.

get.description: Typo-tolerant q over title/author (pg_trgm), genre slugs (any of), year range, sort newest|title|rating (relevance when q is set and sort is omitted), page/pageSize (max 48). A status other than active is librarian-only.
Archived books are 404 for readers and visible to librarians.

patch.description: Requires the current `version`; a stale version is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT carrying the current book.

get.description: Archived books appear with available=false: state locked, removal allowed.

post.summary: Add a book to my reading list
post.description: Idempotent; re-adding a removed book reactivates its entry.

post.summary: Remove or re-state several books on my reading list at once
post.description: At most 10 changes, each book once, only books already on the list (adding is one book at a time). All or nothing: 404 if one book is not on the list, 409 BOOK_ARCHIVED for a state change on an archived book, and then nothing changes.

patch.description: 409 BOOK_ARCHIVED when the book has been archived.

delete.summary: Remove a book from my reading list

put.description: Ordered list of 0–5 active genre ids; position is the index. Dropped genres are soft-removed and reactivated if chosen again.

get.description: Up to six active books from your favourite genres that are not on your reading list.
Every catalog and account mutation, newest first, with who did it and what it was about. Filter by one or more entityType values (comma-separated or repeated).

get.summary: What the AI layer is configured with
get.description: Provider and model ids exactly as configured (never implied), embeddings, enabled features, voice mode.

get.summary: Recent model calls with cost and latency

post.description: Parses free text (English, Arabic or French) into a validated BooksQuery plus editable chips. Nothing is searched here: the client applies the query to GET /books. `meta.ai` carries the model, tokens, cost and latency; 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE means "use the plain search".

post.summary: Draft a book from an ISBN or a title
post.description: Looks the book up in the external catalog (Open Library), then lets the small model fill only the gaps: author, first-publication year, synopsis and genres from the live list. Every field carries its source (lookup, input, model, empty) and a confidence. Nothing is saved. `meta.lookupHit` says whether the catalog knew the book; `meta.aiUnavailable` means the provider was down and the draft is lookup-only (still 200).

get.summary: Hybrid search: lexical + semantic, fused (RRF k = 60), optional rerank
get.description: The catalog search and a KNN over the book embeddings, 20 candidates each, fused with reciprocal rank fusion. `rerank=true` reorders the top 20 with the small model (only ids it was shown); absent, the server default applies (HYBRID_SEARCH_RERANK). `scores.lexical` is the lexical rank, `scores.semantic` the cosine similarity, `scores.fused` the RRF score. Active books only. A provider outage degrades to the lexical leg (`meta.ai.fallbackUsed`); `meta.rerank` says how the rerank went: off, applied, invalid (fused order kept) or unavailable.

post.summary: One turn of the librarian agent
post.description: The strong model answers with the catalog tools your role allows (readers never get draftBook). Books it mentions are cited by id, and only ids a tool returned survive. Nothing is ever changed here: a reading-list change comes back as `pendingAction` with a signed token, to be confirmed or cancelled with POST /ai/actions/confirm | cancel. Tool results are data, never instructions. 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE when the model is down.

get.summary: Up to six books for you, each explained by books on your reading list
get.description: The small model picks from at most twelve candidates (your favourite genres, best rated, and the books nearest to your shelf by meaning) and explains each pick in a sentence that cites your own reading-list entries. Only candidates can be recommended and only entries it was shown can be cited. `meta.reason`: ok, no-history (empty shelf, no model call), no-candidates, or fallback (invalid output twice: an empty list). 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE when the model is down; the page then shows the plain "For your shelves" list.

post.summary: Run a change the agent proposed
post.description: Shared by text chat and voice. The token must be signed by this server, unexpired (10 min) and issued to you: 401 CONFIRM_TOKEN_INVALID otherwise, 403 for another user's token. Each action is decided once: a second confirm or cancel, concurrent or not, is 409 ACTION_ALREADY_DECIDED. The tool runs with the input from the token, through the same services and role checks as the REST endpoints.

get.description: The nearest active books to this book by embedding (cosine), itself excluded. Empty until the book is embedded by the configured model. Readers get 404 for an archived book.
